request.prompt: A wide elevation looking north from a low clearing where a coast road divides at a cut standing stone. Two roads leave the clearing side by side: on the left a level dry road on the turf; on the right a lane sunk three metres below the fields, standing water lying in it and old field banks either side. Both roads run away from the viewer and rejoin on a broad grassy shoulder in the middle distance, and from that shoulder a short flight climbs to a headland burial ground on the skyline, open to the sea, a single cut grave and low weathered marker stones. Dawn light from the right. No figures.
request.style_note: Sallow Reach, in the same hand throughout: a cold northern coast at first light, low raking sun, wet grey-green turf and chalk, sea wall and standing floodwater, muted earth palette with one warm note from lantern light. Loose painterly gouache with visible brushwork, no ink outlines, no lettering anywhere. Each image is ONE single full-frame view of that place, filling the frame edge to edge: never a sheet, never a grid, never a panel, never an inset or a caption.
